Name: BFAV Fancy Ducks
Author: cantabileChaos
Description:
BUG NOTICED:

Some users have noticed a bug where the ducks cannot be interacted with aside from the initial petting for the day. I have been running tests trying to find out what causes this, but can't figure it out. If anyone knows what causes this and how to fix it, please let me know or leave a comment on the mod to help others out!


Adds 7 varieties of ducks and 4 feather types.

Fancy ducks are slightly more expensive and produce slightly more valuable feathers.

Black feathers are loved by Sebastian and Krobus
Iridescent feathers are loved by Wizard and Leah

Downloads.Description: Includes ducks and feathers. Small coding issue fixed.
